# Supplemental dependency licenses

Some npm packages declare a license but omit its full text from the published
package. These copies preserve the upstream notice in generated dependency
notices; no dependency source is vendored here.

- `licenses/abstract-logging.txt`: MIT notice from the author's license page,
  `https://jsumners.mit-license.org/license.txt`, linked by abstract-logging 2.0.1's README.
- `licenses/client-only.txt`: MIT notice from React's v19.2.0 repository LICENSE,
  `https://github.com/facebook/react/blob/v19.2.0/LICENSE`. The client-only 0.0.1
  package identifies itself as a React marker package and declares MIT.
